Requirement Text (Original Requirement): System shall use transaction management software (BMS version 2.0), card management software (CMS version 3.0), and Yamaha codecs.
reviewer_reasoning: Mandates particular third-party software versions and codecs, imposing implementation and compatibility constraints rather than a user-facing operation.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall have an ALFRED device easily adaptable for users with visual or hearing impairments.
reviewer_reasoning: Adaptability for people with visual or hearing impairments is an accessibility quality property; 'easily' lacks a measurable criterion.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall experience a great UI and UX for a pleasant navigation experience.
reviewer_reasoning: Expresses perceived usability and user experience rather than a specific operation, although 'great' and 'pleasant' are not measurable.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The automated diagnostic tool shall detect and identify certain performance and operational faults in chiller and cooling tower subsystems of HVAC units following specified algorithms.
reviewer_reasoning: Requires the tool to detect and identify specified HVAC faults using algorithms; this is explicit diagnostic functionality.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall ensure safe transactions.
reviewer_reasoning: Calls for transaction safety/security as a quality outcome without specifying an executable mechanism or defined threshold.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): All users shall be able to navigate to the Catalogue using the sub navigation icons.
reviewer_reasoning: Provides a specific navigational action: users can open the Catalogue via sub-navigation icons.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall access different modes for adding filters and effects to scenes and images, enhancing versatility and customization options.
reviewer_reasoning: Enables selecting modes to add image or scene filters and effects; versatility is a benefit of that functionality.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall be able to make payments securely through integrated payment gateways like PayPal, InterSwitch, etc.
reviewer_reasoning: Requires users to make payments through integrated gateways, which is functionality; 'securely' adds a security quality requirement.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The product shall be designed with very limited graphics usage and shall utilize a simple keypad for user input.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies design and interface constraints: limited graphics and a simple keypad, rather than a discrete operation.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall be able to view the customer homepage after logging in.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies the ability to display the customer homepage after login.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall allow the use of unverified (anonymous) avatars or aliases.
reviewer_reasoning: Requires allowing anonymous avatars or aliases; this is an explicit permitted system behavior.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall support the following operating systems - Windows 10/11 (32-bit or 64-bit) and Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, or Windows Server 2012 (including R2)
reviewer_reasoning: Lists supported operating-system platforms and versions, a compatibility/portability constraint.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.
reviewer_reasoning: Allows selecting a language from supported target-market languages, a user interaction capability.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): System shall have a strong network of servers managed by a qualified team to handle application functionality worldwide.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies infrastructure and operational staffing to support worldwide service, but 'strong' and 'qualified' are undefined.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall provide basic usage metrics for administrators
reviewer_reasoning: Requires displaying or supplying usage metrics to administrators, a specified reporting capability.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): System shall restrict access to modules based on user roles, preventing students from updating marks.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies role-based authorization behavior, including disallowing students from editing marks.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall allow users to create unverified (anonymous) avatars or aliases.
reviewer_reasoning: Allows users to create anonymous avatars or aliases, an explicit creation operation.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall be able to respond to a limited number of profiles per day as a general job seeker.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies a per-day quota governing a user's ability to respond to profiles; it is a functional business rule.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): System shall allow browsing content by author or subject area.
reviewer_reasoning: Requires browsing content by author or subject, a concrete search/navigation function.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): System shall generate logs of user bank account details, account updates with date, time, and changes, and fixed asset schedules.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies generation of account-change and asset-schedule logs; auditability is a possible quality motivation.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall have sufficient hardware resources to support all functionalities of Adobe Illustrator without limitations due to insufficient hardware.
reviewer_reasoning: Specifies resource-capacity constraints necessary to run Adobe Illustrator functions, not new application behavior.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): System shall enable sponsors to link attendees to their sponsorship page.
reviewer_reasoning: Allows sponsors to link attendees to sponsorship pages, a defined workflow action.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall be able to interact with the text-based command-line interface of the system.
reviewer_reasoning: Requires the ability to interact with the system via CLI; could instead be classified as an interface/platform constraint under another taxonomy.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall be able to monitor the overall data processing rate, compare it to tolerances, and report any deviations from those tolerances.
reviewer_reasoning: Requires monitoring processing rates, comparing them to tolerances, and reporting deviations; these are operational functions rather than a direct throughput target.

Requirement Text (Original Requirement): The system shall allow authorized users to delete sub-apps and their launchers within the main application.
reviewer_reasoning: Allows authorized users to delete sub-apps and launchers; a specific access-controlled deletion function.
